page.layout: One page of text, left printed page; in the right margin of the scan, cropped text from the facing page (partly visible running words and catchwords). Signature mark "A 3" at the foot of the left page, faint.

main_text.p: cuntur? Si aliqvid qvoq; occurrat;qvod aptum sit, risum movere, cogitari velim illud Platonis in Sympos. Non reformido, ut aliqvid, qvod risum moveat, in medium afferam (hoc enim Musae nostrae proprium est & peculiare emolumentum, & qvasi gentile) sed ne ridicula dicam. Tibi, lector, extra livo-rem

page.notes: The facing right-hand page is only partly visible at the edge of the scan (fragments such as "rem", "prim", "tuae", "plac", "tiap", "vol", "trat", "Feb"); these are cropped, not transcribed as text. The last line "extra livo-rem" is printed as "extralivo." with "rem" at the line end; the hyphen-less line ending "livo." is read as printed. The word "cuntur?" at the top may be "cuntur" with a mark that is partly obscured. Faint "A 3" signature is at the foot.
